{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''language''' was spoken by the [[Anointed People]] of [[Abonshee]]. Around [[89 BBY]], Abonshee was visited by a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] expedition. The scouts discovered the locals and their [[Language/Legends|language]], and included a translation program in their report about the Anointed People.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
